name: Inn to the Dartness
detailed_description:
Inn to the Dartness

You wake up in a dark Inn, surrounded by strange creatures. Your only way out? Playing darts… but here, the rules have changed. Welcome to Inn to the Dartness, a unique roguelike blending strategy and precision !

A roguelike where darts take center stage !

Sharpen your aim and creativity to overcome each round, where every throw counts. Upgrade your darts, manipulate the target, and discover crazy effects that will completely change the game !

Unexpected and powerful upgrades

Experiment with hundreds of synergies thanks to cryptic trinkets, customizable darts, and… a lot of drinks. But be careful—too much of the tavern’s finest might just send your aim spinning!

A strange and captivating world

Step into a mysterious pub filled with odd entities, and let yourself be guided by a sarcastic companion who will be the first to mock your victories… and your failures.

Quick runs, endless replayability

With runs lasting under 30 minutes and infinite upgrade combinations, Inn to the Dartness is perfect for both challenge-seekers and players looking for instant fun.

Are you ready to hit the bullseye or lose yourself in madness? Inn to the Dartness awaits !

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
